owner_priority_lock.rule: Follow the explicit owner direction to pause technical_refactor and prioritize tour-search UX and user-facing visual work on AnyTour Design System 2.0.

current_stage.name: Representative country/editorial DS2 re-audit after country detail geometry fix
current_stage.last_material_progress: PR #695 fixed a confirmed responsive geometry defect shared by representative country detail pages: the three 'Что важно при выборе' fact cards inherited the generic balanced-three tablet fallback and became an awkward 2+1 layout with a centered half-width orphan card at 1024/768. The fix is scoped to .sp-country-page: country facts stay three equal columns through 901–1024 and become one calm editorial column at <=900, while the generic balanced-three behavior used by /hot/ and other routes is unchanged. All eight PR gates passed. Deploy V2 only and Deploy anytoour.ru completed successfully; public-page verification, unchanged lead bridge and live-search smoke passed. Post-deploy responsive navigation, live user journey, migrated-content, live results/selected-tour and V2 baseline checks are green; the broad five-width standalone-content production run is still completing independently and has no reported failure at this resume point. Search/Tourvisor, analytics/Metrika, legal/payment wording, logo, verified destinations, pricing and lead transport were unchanged.
current_stage.next_action: Continue the representative country/editorial re-audit at 375/430/768/1024/1440 from /country/ catalog into representative country detail hero/facts/related-destination and the handoff into /hot/ and /poisk-turov/. First consume the current five-width production evidence from PR #695; if it is green and no second defect is confirmed, move to shared breadcrumb/footer/CTA hierarchy across the country/editorial shell rather than inventing route-local styling. Preserve the mature search/results/selected-tour path and loaded-results instant-local-filtering architecture.

local_results_filtering.rule: Result filters such as stars/rating/price/meal and other fields already present in normalized loaded results filter the loaded set instantly. A new Tourvisor search is reserved for real search-input changes or optional background capability expansion, not for every result-filter click.

site_wide_score.note: Country-detail tablet geometry is materially cleaner and the first public-route hierarchy pass remains green, but this is one incremental representative-country correction. Keep 7.2 until the broader country/editorial five-width re-audit provides enough visible product evidence for another whole-site increase.
